question: Which word has been substituted for the words 'Unity of the Nation' in the 42ⁿd Amendment Act of the Preamble of the Constitution of India?

options.text: Unity and honesty of the nation
Unity and equity of the nation
Unity and integrity of the nation
Unity and morality of the nation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Unity and integrity of the nation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **'Unity and integrity of the nation'** was substituted for 'Unity of the Nation' in the 42nd Amendment Act of the Preamble of the Constitution of India.
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act, also known as the **Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976**, is one of the most comprehensive amendments made to the Indian Constitution.
 
• This amendment aimed to make significant changes to the Preamble, including adding the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity'.
 
• The amendment sought to emphasize the importance of national unity and integrity, reflecting the country's commitment to maintaining its territorial integrity and the unity of its people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **42nd Amendment** was enacted during the Emergency period when Indira Gandhi was the Prime Minister of India.
 
• It is sometimes referred to as a "mini-Constitution" due to the extensive changes it brought about.
 
• The amendment also aimed to reduce the power of the judiciary and enhance the authority of the Parliament.
 
• However, some of its provisions were later repealed or modified by subsequent amendments, such as the 44th Amendment Act.
 
• The Preamble reflects the aspirations and values of the Constitution, serving as a guiding principle for its interpretation and implementation.
